name: stylejuicer
description: Turn a public website into an evidence-backed, portable UI style package.

interface.shortDescription: Turn one public URL into portable UI language
interface.longDescription: Scans one bounded public surface, selects representative rendered states, maps public frontend clues, and produces a validated five-artifact UI style package without copying the source identity.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use StyleJuicer to extract this public website's portable UI language and validate the five-artifact evidence package.
